name: RealFusion
definition: A method for 3D reconstruction from a single image by optimizing a radiance field using two simultaneous objectives: a reconstruction objective from a fixed viewpoint and a SDS-based prior objective on novel views, utilizing single-image textual inversion to substitute for alternative views.
summary: RealFusion reconstructs 360-degree 3D models from single images using diffusion priors and textual inversion to avoid the mode collapse common in text-based methods.
